Sometimes a bubble gun can be used to shoot at distant enemies, trapping them helplessly inside floating soap-bubbles, until they can be eliminated with a tail-sweep at close range.

160410.overview:
TREAD THE BOARDS IN 13 WEST END MUSICALS

Perform with family and friends
Sing and Dance to Original Cast Recordings

The songs in this game work with any Nintendo licensed USB microphone

160460.overview: Adibou and the Magic Seasons on Wii invites you to the Celesta planet in which swarm creatures and magical places. The game offers various mini-games within the reach of the little ones in a childish universe. Note that the entire title is voiced for children who do not yet know how to read.

160461.overview: Nothing appears as they seem in this whimsical shooter that takes you on a bizarre trip through the imagination. Full of color and personality, this unique title is fun for everyone and will have you laughing, guessing and entertained all at the same time!

160462.overview:
Musical game based on the TV hit “Atrévete a Soñar”. Players will choose their favorite character (Patito or Antonella) and perform the songs of the show singing, dancing or doing both at once, taking advantage of the movement sensor with the Wiimote and using the microphone, specially designed for the console that is included with the game.

Features
•Become a popular or a divine and take your singing and dancing to the stage through the Wii-Mote and the microphone.
•Receive the audience’s applause and the score from the judges according to your performance.
•Get points and climb the ladder of success.
•20 songs from the show “Atrevete a Soñar”, 19 characters from the original series, including the populars, divines, boys, adults and 10 different scenarios.
•Play with up to 4 friends as Populars or Divines!
•More than 50 elements to customize your characters.

171243.overview: Another Super Mario Bros. Wii is a rom hack of New Super Mario Bros. Wii created solely by Skawo, which was a simple level hack with some extra tweaks. Each of the Worlds' theme and map stayed the same, while the levels were remade using the same themes.

177066.overview: Akko de Pon! Ikasama Hourouki is a mahjong game that brings the full stock of "Ikasama" skills, that is to say fraud and trickery has been fully implemented. Enjoy thrilling Ikasama mahjong that you can't taste in traditional mahjong games! It is also possible to play normal mahjong.

177108.overview:
"And-Kensaku" is a game where you can enjoy various word games by using the "number of hits" that shows how many words and phrases are used on the Internet.

Play while thinking about how a certain word is used, what kind of word is popular, popular topics, and possible combinations of words. You may also find a surprising gap with your image.

Since the search data of more than 10,000 words and phrases is recorded in the game in advance, you can play without connecting to the Internet.

You can also download the latest words, hits, and additional issues from time to time by connecting to the Internet, and enjoy information that reflects actual trends

177120.overview: Anime Slot Revolution: Pachi-Slot Kidou Senshi Gundam II - Ai Senshi Hen (ﾊﾟﾁｽﾛ｢機動戦士ガンダムII 〜哀･戦士編〜｣) is an Gundam based slot machine title.

177142.overview: Play as your favorite professional basketball players in ACB Total 2010/2011. Developed by Korner Entertainment, this game features over 200 players in the Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto 2010/2011 season. Match up real ACB players against a friend in exciting muliplayer mode.

180323.overview:
Anpanman Niko Niko Party (麵包超人 微笑派對(日)) (aka "Breadman Super Smile Party") is an adaptation game of the classic "Bread Superman" which was extended in 1973 after the debut of the picture book and later adapted to TV animation. The game was recorded by the original voice actor of TV animation. Debut characters, as well as familiar topics / insert songs.

The game uses the celluloid 3D drawing method to faithfully present the original images and movements of the animation. It contains a variety of ingenious and easy-to-understand games. It provides dynamic and somatosensory operation through the Wii Remote, and supports up to 3 players.

180325.overview: A Aquarius themed game released as a gift for the contest winners.

188490.overview: Imagine that you're on an island full of dogs. In The Dog Island for Nintendo Wii, you play as a dog whose brother/sister falls ill one day. In order to help your brother/sister, you head to an island in search of a legendary flower. The game includes stages in grass planes, snowy fields and even deserts. You can also choose your dog from a variety of breeds. This is an adorable adventure for kids, based on the best-selling franchise 'THE DOG'.

199869.overview: Another New collection of NSMBW custom levels for your entertainment. This custom has been brought to you by: ANDY AFRO from the DarkUmbra.

199870.overview:
A Collection of Custom NSMBW Levels  Made Up of Spare Worlds and Spare Levels but I have had fun testing it. Some Levels are short but there are also Some Great Levels in there for You to Test.

All Credit Given to the Makers of Levels Within Game as Usual;Big Thanks to all those at DU who continue to support me. (BIG THANKS TO MOOKIE AND WIICREW FOR THEIR EXTRA HELP AS WELL AS SHADOWPUPPET FOR UPLOADING THE COVERS)

204377.overview:
AFL offers gamers the chance to experience real footballer action via visceral Wii Remote motion controls. Gameplay features such as mini contests, specky's, smothers, handballs, kicks, evade, hip and shoulder and tackles all provide precise, realistic sports action. A ten-year Career Manager Mode gives gamers an extended play experience over the life of the game. Plus, you can engage your friends in multiplayer matches of up to eight players.

AFL Live Game of the Year Edition is packed with original content, as well as new features and updates:
Lead your team to Premiership glory see and feel every big play with the ultimate in realistic movement, motion captured from real players.
Tackle, bump, fend and spoil, or take massive speckies
View multiple camera settings and dramatic replays
Utilise 2012 team lists and on-field uniforms
Experience the new Skoda Stadium
Play with a completely new team the Greater Western Sydney Giants
Listen to expert commentary from Dennis Cometti and Brian Taylor
Create and customise unique players and teams

208421.overview:
A masterpiece of game design originally released in the early days of the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, ActRaiser’s enduring popularity stems from its revolutionary combination of action- and simulation-based game play. The user plays the role of the Master, a dethroned deity whose once idyllic world has fallen under the control of the Evil One. Stripped of godly power, the Master must somehow put an end to the Evil One’s reign and rebuild his desolate realm.
Game play alternates between two modes: Action and Simulation. In Action mode, the Master must battle against impossible odds to pacify six lands. Pacifying a land unlocks Simulation mode. In this mode, the Master must oversee the development and repopulation of the territory he has reclaimed. In doing so, he will gain followers who gradually restore his godly might, empowering him to take back the next land and, ultimately, defeat the Evil One.

211116.overview: As Epsilon-Eagle, you are an alien soldier who has been genetically engineered to produce maximum intelligence and strength. You were once a member of the criminal organization Scarlet, but when you decided to break from the group, you were forced into a showdown with Scarlet's new leader Xi-Tiger, who kills a hostage in his attempt to destroy you. Now it's up to you to take revenge against the bad guys in this side-scrolling action game!

212667.overview: In the peaceful country of Transylvania, there is a legend of an evil castle and its master, the Prince of Darkness, Dracula. Once every hundred years, the powers of good mysteriously weaken, and evil attempts to resurrect Dracula. It's up to the Belmont clan to take up the eternal fight against the vampire. Players take on the role of Simon Belmont, armed with the legendary whip, Vampire Killer, to defeat Dracula and his evil minions. Luckily, Simon has many additional weapons at his disposal, including axes, holy water, crosses, knives and even a magical stopwatch that can stop the flow of time for a spell. Simon must travel through 11 stages, beginning in the countryside, to reach Dracula's Castle, all the while overcoming perilous traps and hideous monsters. Only the power of the Belmonts can quell the looming darkness.

418901.overview:
Dawn of Discovery takes place in the year 1404, when King George’s land is suffering from severe droughts and brutal famine. Aware of his people’s distress, the king calls on his two sons, William and Edward, to acquire new territories in order to produce enough goods to satisfy the needs of his empire’s inhabitants. Whereas Edward suggests aggressive means to collect the precious resources, his brother William offers a peaceful solution, proposing to explore new and unsettled lands in the south of the kingdom.

With his Father’s blessing, William heads south to the mysterious Orient and returns with valuable new technologies such as the water pump that allows dry lands to be cultivated in order to produce enough food for the people. But there are still many unmet needs within the king’s empire, and players are tasked with the mission of fulfilling those needs while both expanding and sustaining the vast society.

459377.overview: Animal Crossing: City Folk Deluxe is an unofficial enhancement patch for Animal Crossing: City Folk / Let's Go to the City that introduces new content and gameplay changes. It can be played on any homebrew-enabled Wii or Wii U via Riivolution; no backup images or hardware mods needed. Online play is mostly supported thanks to the services of Wiimmfi and WiiLink.
